help.title: Help Center
help.hero_subtitle: Find answers, learn the rules, and get the most out of Guess-History.
help.contact_text: Cannot find what you are looking for? Reach out and we will get back to you shortly.
help.ql_gs_blurb: Learn the basics and start your first game in under a minute.
help.ql_steps_blurb: Understand the map, year slider, hints, and submission flow.
help.ql_faq_blurb: See how location and time accuracy translate into points.
help.ql_mp_blurb: Create a lobby, invite friends, and compete in real time.
help.gs_01_desc: Sign up with email or use a social login. Choose a display name and pick a historical figure as your avatar.
help.gs_02_desc: Start with Practice mode to learn the ropes. The timer is optional (15 s–5 min), and you have unlimited retries—just explore and get comfortable.
help.gs_03_desc: Once ready, tackle the Daily Challenge. Same events as everyone else—see how you rank on the global leaderboard.
help.gs_04_desc: Create a Compete lobby, copy the room code, and invite friends. Choose Rush for real-time action or Relax for turn-based play.
help.step_observe_blurb: Study the historical image and any visible clues in the photo.
help.step_locate_blurb: Drop a pin on the map where you believe the event took place.
help.step_date_blurb: Set the year using the slider or by typing directly.
help.step_submit_blurb: Lock in your guess before the timer runs out (if enabled).
help.gm_practice_desc: Hone your skills with unlimited practice games. The timer is optional and filters are fully customizable.
help.gm_practice_features: Optional timer (15 s–5 min), Unlimited retries, Custom era and region filters, Instant feedback
help.gm_daily_desc: A new challenge every day. Same events for everyone. Climb the global leaderboard.
help.gm_daily_features: 24-hour window, Global leaderboard, One attempt per day, XP multiplier
help.gm_levelup_desc: Beat levels and earn XP to unlock harder challenges. A true test of skill.
help.gm_levelup_features: Progressive difficulty, Unlockable content, Streak bonuses, Level-specific eras
help.gm_compete_desc: Real-time Rush or turn-based Relax. Create a lobby, invite friends, compete.
help.gm_compete_features: Rush (timed), Relax (async), Up to 8 players, Room codes
help.cat_placing_desc: Click anywhere on the world map to drop a pin. You can zoom, pan, and search for locations. The closer your pin is to the actual event location, the higher your score. You can move the pin as many times as you want before submitting.
help.cat_year_desc: Use the year slider or type directly to pick when you think the event occurred. The year range is customizable per game (default is from 400 BC to the current year). The smaller the gap between your guess and the actual year, the more points you earn.
help.cat_hints_desc: Hints are free, not purchased. Each hint tier reduces the relevant raw accuracy by a percentage: tier 1 = 10%, tier 2 = 20%, tier 3 = 30%, tier 4 = 40%, tier 5 = 50%. Penalties are applied proportionally and capped at 100%, so a hint can never reduce a score below 0%.
help.cat_badges_desc: Earn Gold (100%), Silver (95–99%), or Bronze (90–94%) badges for Year accuracy, Location accuracy, or a balanced Combo score. Near-misses (88–89%) are shown when you just miss a badge. Badges are for instant feedback; your stats and XP are what persist.
help.cat_account_desc: Set your display name and choose a historical figure as your avatar. View your overall accuracy, total XP, member since date, and manage your account details from the Account page.
help.cat_notifications_desc: Get notified when a friend invites you to a game. Tap the bell icon on the top bar to view recent activity.
help.faq_a1: Each round gives up to 200 XP: up to 100 for WHERE and 100 for WHEN. Location accuracy is 100 * exp(-distanceKm / 1500), capped at 20,000 km. Year accuracy is 100 * exp(-effectiveYearDiff / 40), where effectiveYearDiff is your year gap divided by an era scale (sqrt((referenceYear - eventYear) / 50), with a minimum age of 50 years). Hint penalties are then applied proportionally to the raw scores.
help.faq_q2: Can I play without an account?
help.faq_a2: You can browse the home page, but you need an account to play games, save progress, earn XP, and compete against friends. Signing up is free and only takes a moment.
help.faq_q3: What are the different game modes?
help.faq_a3: Practice is a solo warm-up with an optional timer and unlimited retries. Daily Challenge offers the same events for everyone every 24 hours with a global leaderboard. Compete lets you face friends in real-time Rush or turn-based Relax matches. Level Up is planned but not yet available.
help.faq_a4: Hints are free. Each hint belongs to one of five tiers and reduces the relevant raw accuracy by a percentage: tier 1 = 10%, tier 2 = 20%, tier 3 = 30%, tier 4 = 40%, tier 5 = 50%. The penalty is applied proportionally, so a hint can never make a score negative. Year hints are additionally age-discounted by era scale, making older events cheaper to hint.
help.faq_a5: In Compete mode, create a lobby and invite friends via a 6-character room code. You can play synchronous Rush (timed, all players guess together) or asynchronous Relax (take turns at your own pace). Games support up to 8 players with host-controlled settings.
help.faq_q6: Can I zoom into the image?
help.faq_a6: Yes, the historical image can be zoomed. Use pinch-to-zoom on mobile, scroll-wheel zoom on desktop, or tap the zoom controls. You can also open a fullscreen viewer with pan and zoom. Study the photo carefully—look for architecture, clothing, vegetation, landmarks, and any visible text or flags.
help.faq_q7: What happens if the timer runs out?
help.faq_a7: In Rush mode, if you do not submit before the timer expires, your guess is automatically submitted at the current pin location and selected year. In Relax mode, there is no timer—take your time.
help.faq_q8: Why did not my invite arrive?
help.faq_a8: Make sure your friend has an account and is logged in. Invites appear in the notification bell. If they still do not see it, try refreshing the page or sending the room code directly via chat.
help.faq_a9: Badges are awarded based on accuracy per round: Gold (100%), Silver (95–99%), Bronze (90–94%). You can earn Year badges, Location badges, or Combo badges when both scores are high. Near-misses at 88–89% are also shown.
help.kb_esc_action: Close modals and the fullscreen image viewer
help.ts_t1_problem: Game is not loading or stuck on black screen
help.ts_t1_solution: Try refreshing the page. If the issue persists, clear your browser cache and cookies, then reload. Ensure you are using a modern browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge).
help.ts_t2_problem: My friend did not receive the invite
help.ts_t2_solution: Make sure your friend is logged in. Invites appear in the notification bell at the top right. As a fallback, copy the 6-character room code and share it directly via any messaging app.
help.ts_t3_problem: Timer ran out before I could submit
help.ts_t3_solution: In Rush mode, guesses are auto-submitted when time expires. If you need more time, ask the host to disable the timer or switch to Relax mode which has no time limit.
help.ts_t4_problem: Hints are not showing any information
help.ts_t4_solution: Hints are free. Tap the hint button, review the accuracy cost shown, and confirm to reveal the clue. The cost is a percentage penalty applied to your raw score.
help.ts_t5_solution: Check if you used hints—each tier reduces the relevant raw accuracy by 10%-50% proportionally. Also verify your distance from the actual location and year difference. The max per round is 200 XP (100 location + 100 year).
help.cat_rank_progression_desc: Your total XP unlocks 10 rank tiers, from Wanderer (0 XP) to Cartographer Royal (2,500,000 XP). Ranks are derived from your stats and are never stored separately.
help.cat_era_region_desc: Hosts can filter events by era—Ancient, Medieval, Early Modern, Modern, Contemporary—and by world region: Africa, Antarctica, Asia, Europe, North America, Oceania, South America. Only events matching the selected filters will appear in the game.
help.cat_results_auto_advance_desc: After everyone submits, results are shown and the game automatically moves to the next round. The default wait is 90 seconds; hosts can set it from 0 to 300 seconds.
help.cat_relax_deadlines_desc: In Relax (turn-based) mode, each player has up to 14 days to take a turn. The host sets the deadline when creating the game.
help.faq_a10: In Rush mode, as soon as the first player submits a guess, the round timer drops to 30 seconds for everyone still guessing. This keeps the game moving and prevents long waits.
help.kb_enter_action: Open the full player list in the lobby search
